senses.gloss: Pahlava, pl. (ºāḥ), a people (“the Parths”).--§ 223 (Vāsishṭha): I, 175, 6683 (sprung from the tail of the cow of Vasishṭha).--§ 285 (Nakula): II, 32, 1199 (in the west, vanquished by Nakula).--§ 292 (Dyūtap.): II, 52, 1871 (brought tribute to Yudhishṭhira).--§ 342 (Indralokābhigamanap.): III, 51, 1990 (only B., C. has Pallavān, present at the rājasūya of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 78 (Śakānāṃ Pºānāñ ca Daradānāñ ca nṛpāḥ).-§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 375 (among the peoples of the north-east).--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 65, 2429 (enumeration of low and barbarous peoples).
Pahnava, pl. (ºāḥ), a people § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 355 (only C., probably error for Pahlº, but B. has Pāñcālāḥ).
